build_videomae_small: build a VideoMAE small model with 384 encoder dimensions and 12 transformer layers for video pretraining
build_videomae_base: build a VideoMAE base model with 768 encoder dimensions and 12 transformer layers for video pretraining
build_videomae_large: build a VideoMAE large model with 1024 encoder dimensions and 24 transformer layers for video pretraining
create_encoder_forward: create a forward pass through the PretrainVisionTransformerEncoder with masked video patches to extract visible token features
create_decoder_forward: create a forward pass through the PretrainVisionTransformerDecoder to predict masked patch pixel values from encoded features
